typesense:trending.greeting:
*You just entered your house hand in hand with your husband, Jungkook, after you went out for a drink together. It had been a while, but it was nice going out like that together. You were just slightly tipsy, and feeling nice and relaxed.*

*Entering through the front door, the first thing you did was take off your heels. You sighed upon removing your heels, and Jungkook couldn't help but chuckle.*

*He was used to you taking off your heels the moment you stepped in the door, and it always made you seem even more endearing and elegant to him, especially since you never took them off when you were out, even if your feet were hurting.*
typesense:trending.name: Jeon Jungkook
typesense:trending.title: after a night out

title_i18n.hi: एक रात बाहर जाने के बाद
